nodes.label: C++17 Compiler Support Check
nodes.rationale: Marked in-source as 'a hack -- look for a more robust solution': CH_CXX17 is derived from per-compiler version thresholds (GCC >7.0, Clang >=7.0, MSVC >1914, PGI >=19.1, always for IntelLLVM) because CMake's standard-support flags cannot be trusted for PGI. Configuration returns early if C++17 is unavailable.

nodes.label: CHRONO_GPU_BACKEND Resolution (AUTO / CUDA / HIP)
nodes.rationale: A single cache variable picks the GPU backend. Under AUTO, HIP wins only when a ROCm install of at least CHRONO_HIP_MIN_VERSION (5.7.0) is found, otherwise CUDA is tried; the resolved value is written back into CHRONO_GPU_BACKEND and unused architecture variables are hidden as advanced so the cache does not offer both toolchains at once.

nodes.label: chrono_find_rocm
nodes.rationale: Probes an ordered candidate list (CHRONO_ROCM_ROOT, ROCM_PATH, env ROCM_PATH/ROCM_HOME/HIP_PATH, then /opt/rocm and friends) and accepts the first root whose hip_version.h parses, so an explicit user setting always outranks the conventional install locations.

nodes.label: chrono_read_hip_version
nodes.rationale: Reads HIP_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH straight out of hip_version.h with file(STRINGS) instead of invoking a compiler, so version gating can happen before enable_language(HIP).

nodes.label: HIP Eigen Max Alignment Workaround
nodes.rationale: Host-side Chrono classes hold fixed-size Eigen objects; with AVX Eigen may demand 32-byte alignment, which some allocation paths in demos, visualization and MBS coupling do not guarantee. In HIP builds this aborted demo_FSI-SPH_CouetteFlow before any SPH kernel ran. Capping EIGEN_MAX_ALIGN_BYTES / EIGEN_MAX_STATIC_ALIGN_BYTES at 16 removes the fragile over-alignment requirement while keeping ordinary SSE vectorization, and is scoped to HIP so CUDA/NVIDIA builds are untouched.

nodes.label: ROCm-packaged Thrust Exclusion
nodes.rationale: When a HIP build finds a Thrust whose real include path lives under the ROCm root, Thrust_FOUND is forced false: the ROCm-packaged Thrust is not usable for host-side Chrono targets.

nodes.label: Thrust Detection and CHRONO_THRUST_FOUND
nodes.rationale: Thrust availability gates both the multicore collision detection sources and the CHRONO_COLLISION config macro; FindThrust.cmake is copied into the build tree and installed so downstream projects can repeat the search.

nodes.label: SIMD Detection (SSE / AVX / FMA / NEON)
nodes.rationale: SSE 1.0 and 2.0 are asserted unconditionally on 64-bit x86; higher levels are gated on detected versions. FMA is dropped on MSVC unless whole-program optimization is on, because MSVC only honors it under /GL.

nodes.label: yaml-cpp via FetchContent
nodes.rationale: yaml-cpp is pulled from the in-tree third-party directory through FetchContent rather than being vendored into a target. YAML support is force-disabled on MSVC older than 1930 because a bug prevents yaml-cpp compiling before Visual Studio 2022; several MSVC warnings (C4251/C4275/C4267) are suppressed on the imported target.

nodes.label: Optional Module Subdirectory Registration
nodes.rationale: Each optional module owns its enable option and simply returns early when disabled, so the top level can add every subdirectory unconditionally. Order matters in one place: Chrono::Mumps must be configured before any module that may depend on Intel MKL.

nodes.label: ChConfig.h Feature Macro Generation
nodes.rationale: Every CH_ENABLE_MODULE_* option is translated into a '#define'/'#undef' substitution string and configured into ChConfig.h, giving source code a single header to test capabilities. Noted TODO: the tests check whether a module was enabled, not whether it actually built.

nodes.label: ChronoConfig.cmake and ChronoTargets Export
nodes.rationale: Two configurations of the same ChronoConfig.cmake.in template are generated, one for the install tree and one for the build tree (differing in CH_INSTALL_TREE, CH_BUILD_TREE_DIR and CHRONO_SWIG_DIR), so consumers can use Chrono either from an install prefix or directly out of the build directory. Targets are exported under the Chrono:: namespace.

nodes.label: GoogleTest / Google Benchmark Submodule Gating
nodes.rationale: If the third-party submodule is not checked out the corresponding BUILD_TESTING / BUILD_BENCHMARKING option is force-disabled with a 'update git submodules' message rather than failing configuration.
